# Webhook event normalizer

Normalizes service events for the webhook archive.

## Event contract

Each input has the shape `{ type, data }`. The required fields in `data` and
their normalized values are:

| Event type | `id` source | `occurredAt` source | `actor` source | `kind` | Summary label |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `invoice.paid` | `data.invoiceId` | `data.paidAt` | `data.customer` | `invoice-paid` | Invoice paid |
| `invoice.failed` | `data.invoiceId` | `data.failedAt` | `data.customer` | `invoice-failed` | Invoice failed |
| `user.created` | `data.userId` | `data.createdAt` | `data.email` | `user-created` | User created |
| `user.disabled` | `data.userId` | `data.disabledAt` | `data.email` | `user-disabled` | User disabled |
| `deploy.started` | `data.deploymentId` | `data.startedAt` | `data.initiator` | `deploy-started` | Deployment started |
| `deploy.succeeded` | `data.deploymentId` | `data.finishedAt` | `data.initiator` | `deploy-succeeded` | Deployment succeeded |
| `deploy.failed` | `data.deploymentId` | `data.finishedAt` | `data.initiator` | `deploy-failed` | Deployment failed |
| `alert.opened` | `data.alertId` | `data.openedAt` | `data.service` | `alert-opened` | Alert opened |
| `alert.closed` | `data.alertId` | `data.closedAt` | `data.service` | `alert-closed` | Alert closed |
| `access.granted` | `data.grantId` | `data.grantedAt` | `data.actor` | `access-granted` | Access granted |

The result is exactly `{ id, kind, occurredAt, actor, summary }`.
`occurredAt` preserves the source timestamp text, and `summary` is `<summary label>: <id>`.
Normalization must not modify the input event or its `data` object.

item.text: The README is the complete contract: each type selects four specific source fields, derives a kebab-case `kind`, and formats `summary` as `<label>: <id>`. I’m implementing this table directly, with validation before any field access and no input mutation.

const cases = [['invoice.paid',{invoiceId:'i1',paidAt:'2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',customer:'c1'},'invoice-paid','Invoice paid'],['invoice.failed',{invoiceId:'i2',failedAt:'raw timestamp',customer:'c2'},'invoice-failed','Invoice failed'],['user.created',{userId:'u1',createdAt:'t1',email:'a@example.com'},'user-created','User created'],['user.disabled',{userId:'u2',disabledAt:'t2',email:'b@example.com'},'user-disabled','User disabled'],['deploy.started',{deploymentId:'d1',startedAt:'t3',initiator:'ops'},'deploy-started','Deployment started'],['deploy.succeeded',{deploymentId:'d2',finishedAt:'t4',initiator:'ops'},'deploy-succeeded','Deployment succeeded'],['deploy.failed',{deploymentId:'d3',finishedAt:'t5',initiator:'ops'},'deploy-failed','Deployment failed'],['alert.opened',{alertId:'a1',openedAt:'t6',service:'api'},'alert-opened','Alert opened'],['alert.closed',{alertId:'a2',closedAt:'t7',service:'api'},'alert-closed','Alert closed'],['access.granted',{grantId:'g1',grantedAt:'t8',actor:'admin'},'access-granted','Access granted']]; for (const [type,data,kind,label] of cases) { const input={type,data}; const before=structuredClone(input); const result=normalizeEvent(input); assert.equal(result.kind,kind); assert.equal(result.occurredAt,Object.values(data)[1]);
